name: a5_cell_area
description: Returns the area in square meters of an A5 cell at the specified resolution level (-1 gives the world cell, i.e. the whole globe)

name: a5_get_num_cells
description: Returns the total number of A5 cells at the specified resolution level (0-30)

name: a5_lonlat_to_cell
description: Converts a longitude/latitude coordinate to an A5 cell at the specified resolution

name: a5_max_resolution
description: Returns the finest A5 resolution level (30). Resolutions run from 0 to this value

name: a5_cell_to_boundary
description: Returns the boundary vertices of an A5 cell, optionally as an open or closed ring

name: a5_cell_to_lonlat
description: Returns the center point [longitude, latitude] of an A5 cell

name: a5_cell_to_point
description: Returns the center of an A5 cell as a POINT geometry

name: a5_compact
description: Compacts a list of A5 cells by merging complete sets of sibling cells into parent cells. The result is a covering: compacted cells sorted in curve order, followed by a compaction marker recording the resolution - use a5_uncompact to expand it

name: a5_difference
description: Returns the difference of two lists of A5 cells: the cells in a but not in b. Both lists must be at the same resolution. The result is a covering: compacted cells sorted in curve order, followed by a compaction marker recording the resolution - use a5_uncompact to expand it

name: a5_hex_to_u64
description: Converts an A5 hex string representation to a UBIGINT cell ID

name: a5_cell_to_geometry
description: Returns an A5 cell as a POLYGON geometry, with each edge interpolated into the given number of segments

name: a5_covering_resolution
description: Returns the resolution of a list of A5 cells: the resolution of its compaction marker, or of its finest cell when it has none. Returns -1 for an empty list

name: a5_geometry_to_cells
description: Returns the A5 cells covering an arbitrary geometry at the given resolution. Points map to their containing cell, lines are traced, and polygons are filled with cell-center containment (holes excluded); MULTI* and GEOMETRYCOLLECTION inputs are unioned. A geometry with polygon parts gives a covering: compacted cells sorted in curve order, followed by a compaction marker recording the resolution - use a5_uncompact to expand it. Other geometries give their cells at the resolution, in geometry order

name: a5_get_num_children
description: Returns the number of child cells at child_resolution that fit within a cell at parent_resolution (-1 for the world cell)

name: a5_get_res0_cells
description: Returns all 12 resolution 0 (root) A5 cells covering the entire globe

name: a5_world_cell
description: Returns the A5 world cell, the root cell that covers the entire globe and is the ancestor of all resolution-0 cells

name: a5_area
description: Returns the total area in square meters of a list of A5 cells (compacted or not). Overlapping cells each add their area - use a5_union to merge them first

name: a5_cell_to_boundary
description: Returns the boundary vertices of an A5 cell as a closed ring of [lon, lat] points

name: a5_cell_to_children
description: Returns the immediate child A5 cells (one resolution finer)

name: a5_cell_to_geometry
description: Returns an A5 cell as a POLYGON geometry of its boundary

name: a5_cell_to_parent
description: Returns the parent A5 cell at the specified coarser resolution (-1 gives the world cell)

name: a5_cell_to_subcells
description: Returns the A5 cells at the specified finer resolution whose centers lie in the cell: the spatial counterpart of a5_cell_to_children and the inverse of a5_cell_to_supercell. The result is a covering: compacted cells sorted in curve order, followed by a compaction marker recording the resolution - use a5_uncompact to expand it

name: a5_contains
description: Returns true if the cell is in the list of A5 cells (compacted or not). The cell must be at the resolution of the list, and the list must be sorted in curve order, as coverings are

name: a5_migrate
description: Migrates an A5 cell ID created by a pre-1.0 version of A5 (a5 crate <= 0.10) to the ID of the same cell in the current index. Cell IDs changed in A5 1.0, so stored cell IDs must be migrated once

name: a5_overlaps
description: Returns true if two lists of A5 cells (compacted or not) share any cell. Both lists must be at the same resolution

name: a5_union
description: Returns the union of two lists of A5 cells: the cells in either. Both lists must be at the same resolution. The result is a covering: compacted cells sorted in curve order, followed by a compaction marker recording the resolution - use a5_uncompact to expand it

name: a5_cell_to_boundary
description: Returns the boundary vertices of an A5 cell with configurable ring closure and edge interpolation segments

name: a5_count
description: Returns the number of cells in a list of A5 cells at its resolution, i.e. the length of the uncompacted list. Overlapping cells are counted more than once - use a5_union to merge them first

name: a5_geometry_to_cells
description: Returns the A5 cells covering an arbitrary geometry at the given resolution, as above. For polygon parts, setting overlapping to true additionally includes every cell that touches the polygon boundary, giving gap-free coverage instead of the default cell-center containment

name: a5_get_resolution
description: Returns the resolution level (0-30) of an A5 cell

name: a5_intersect
description: Returns the intersection of two lists of A5 cells: the cells in both. Both lists must be at the same resolution. The result is a covering: compacted cells sorted in curve order, followed by a compaction marker recording the resolution - use a5_uncompact to expand it

name: a5_u64_to_hex
description: Converts a UBIGINT A5 cell ID to its hex string representation

name: a5_cell_edge_length_avg
description: Returns the average edge length in meters of an A5 cell at the specified resolution level; individual edges vary from the average by roughly +/-10%

name: a5_is_compaction_marker
description: Returns true if the value is a compaction marker: the last element of a covering (as returned by a5_compact, a5_grid_disk, a5_spherical_cap, a5_cell_to_subcells, polygon coverings and the set operations), recording the resolution its cells stand for. A compaction marker is not a cell

name: a5_spherical_cap
description: Returns all A5 cells within the specified radius (in meters) of the given cell, as a covering: compacted cells sorted in curve order, followed by a compaction marker recording the resolution - use a5_uncompact to expand it

name: a5_grid_disk
description: Returns all A5 cells within k edge-steps of the given cell (edge adjacency), as a covering: compacted cells sorted in curve order, followed by a compaction marker recording the resolution - use a5_uncompact to expand it

name: a5_is_valid_cell
description: Returns true if the value is a valid A5 cell ID (a canonically-encoded cell). The world cell (0) is considered valid

name: a5_cell_to_children
description: Returns all child A5 cells at the specified finer resolution

name: a5_cell_to_parent
description: Returns the immediate parent A5 cell (one resolution coarser)

name: a5_cell_to_supercell
description: Returns the A5 cell at the specified coarser resolution that contains the center of the cell: the spatial counterpart of a5_cell_to_parent, whose result need not contain the cell (-1 gives the world cell)

name: a5_grid_disk_vertex
description: Returns all A5 cells within k vertex-steps of the given cell (vertex adjacency), as a covering: compacted cells sorted in curve order, followed by a compaction marker recording the resolution - use a5_uncompact to expand it

name: a5_uncompact
description: Expands a list of A5 cells to all their cells at the resolution of the list: the resolution of its compaction marker, or of its finest cell when it has none. The compaction marker is dropped from the result
